steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Aroma, this is to notify you that you have passed the evaluation period.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: The Recruitment and Assessment Section's application records show that due to your excellent performance, you've also received invitations from other departments.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: That said, you will get to decide which department to join.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: When will I have to make my decision by?

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: You just have to let me know by the end of the week.

steps.name: HR Operator
steps.text: Choose carefully.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I'll think it over. Thanks.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator A
steps.text: Rubber, what's going on? The laundry room's under maintenance again?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Sorry! The laundry machines malfunctioned. Sorry about the trouble.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Logistics and Engineering will have it fixed as soon as possible, and we'll make an announcement about when it'll be open again.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator A
steps.text: But I was in the line for so long...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator B
steps.text: Alright, alright. These things happen. Let's just head back.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Sorry, we'll try to get it fixed ASAP.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Look at the time. Where's Aroma?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: She's not here to help with the laundry. What should I do...?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: But it'll probably give her a headache when she finds out there are so many last minute laundry orders, right?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Oh well, work takes priority. I'll head to the dorm and see if I can find her there.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: How's the water temperature?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Can we make it a little hotter?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: And the pressure?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Hm... Pretty good. It feels really nice.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Can you go a little higher? Right, help me with that spot there.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Okay, I'll keep the brush at this height.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: If anything feels at all off, feel free to give me a call.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Aroma, isn't this tail hydrotherapy equipment great? It's Engineering's latest masterpiece!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I think it's really helping.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: But is testing out the hydrotherapy machine all there is to today's seminar?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Well, it's important. It's a product that's gonna be servicing people, so of course we need user feedback!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Of course, that's just part of the seminar.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: You've been working so hard over at Logistics, Aroma. It must be tough on you, huh?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Feel free to come relax any time you want, even after the seminars are over!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Huh? Can I really?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I'll stay for a little longer while it's still my lunch break, then. I'll have lots to do in the afternoon.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: You're more than welcome to. And if you have any more suggestions, all the better.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: All this R&D work is necessary for Engineering to provide everyone with even better beauty treatments.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Um, if I remember correctly, beauty treatments should be the responsibility of Logistics.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: So why did you choose Engineering when you formally joined Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Aroma—

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: ...She's not in her dorm room either... Weird. Where did she go?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Hm? There's a copy of Hair Care and Maintenance Techniques on her desk.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Look at all these notes... She's really been studying up on these techniques.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Huh? Something fell out of the book... A notice about the Engineering Department's seminar?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Wait, the Engineering Department?!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Her trial period's almost over...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: No way... Does this mean she wants to leave Logistics?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hey, Rubber, is Aroma here?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Hey, Purestream. What's wrong?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: The communal bath's scheduled for a routine cleaning today, and I wanted to ask if she has time to help out!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: The bath? Why Aroma? Isn't there somebody else in charge of cleaning that?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Huh? A-Actually, that's me.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Are you telling me it's not just the communal bath, but... Every single place that needs cleaning on this entire landship has been trying to get Aroma's help?!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Not only does she help deal with oily messes after the kitchen's cooking mishaps, she also helps pick up the splinters from broken training dummies?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: She even cleans up the Convalescent Garden's baitbugs? She's terrified of bugs!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: When you put it like that, she must be way overworked...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Hm, but she always makes it look so easy when helping out. She really helps with our efficiency.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: You know, now that I think about it, my first thought is to get her to help with the pile of dirty laundry every time the laundry room's closed for maintenance...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: *sigh*... Aroma's been the backbone of Logistics for a while now but we've never actually talked to her about joining us officially.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: She knows so much, picks everything up so quickly, and is such a meticulous hard worker... Engineering might actually be trying to poach her.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Wait, what do you mean...?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: This won't do. I need to get the laundry orders divvied up, on the double. I can't keep loading Aroma with so much work.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: We can't afford to lose her.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: So Roberta... you chose to join Engineering because technology can help reduce everyone's workloads?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Right. I mean, we can only do so much ourselves.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: I could be a hundred times more energetic, but I'd still never be able to give every single operator a makeover in one day, right?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Similarly, you wouldn't be able to clean all of Rhodes Island in one day, right?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: But with an auto-modeler, or some kind of automatic cleaning machine, everybody's work gets that much easier.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: And then more operators could enjoy our services faster, right? Even getting the wait times under a day isn't out of the question.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: I want to provide a faster, more convenient service to more people. That's why.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: That's true...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: But Roberta, will these machines ultimately replace people entirely?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Huh? Where's this coming from?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: It just suddenly occurred to me that... maybe machines would be much better at repetitive daily work than me.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: That's not how this works, Aroma.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Although machines have been replacing people after many, many iterations, I still think they each have their own advantages.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: 'Sometimes, only a person knows why something needs to be done.'

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: My grandma said something similar once.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Oh, that reminds me. Siracusans do seem to trust human handiwork more.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: The famiglie would take an obedient carwash worker over an ice-cold set of automatic carwash equipment any day.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Kinda brings me back.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: If I remember correctly, you were born in Siracusa too, weren't you?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I left when I was still very young, though.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Me too. I haven't been back for a long time.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I've heard from our Siracusan operators that the country has changed a lot.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: So you want to go back and have a look?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Oh, I just got a notification on my terminal.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: It's a schedule change notice.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: That's weird. All my work for this afternoon has been canceled.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Is this a holiday or something...?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Let me ask Rubber.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Busy...? How come... Never mind.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Since you have time, want to try another product?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: The hydrotherapy's auto mode is almost done. I also have a makeup applier while-you-sleep and a supersonic tooth cleaning machine currently under development.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Oh, that's fine. Thank you, though.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: But there's actually something else I wanted to ask you about.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Take a look at this.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Is this... an application to submit an engineering blueprint?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Yep, all the cleaning work's been reassigned. Purestream and I will help her take care of the some of the other things she was supposed to work on.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: I was surprised there was so much non-cleaning work, though. Not only does she make herbal dishes at the cafeteria, she was also scheduled to install anti-static equipment in the corridors...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: *sigh*, never mind. I'll cancel all of them for her and ask other Logistics operators to cover those.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Next, we have the tough part.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Hello, is Aroma here?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Oh, she just took an engineering blueprint to Roberta.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: A blueprint?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: That's right. She asked Weedy to teach her how to draw one.

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: I've seen her bringing all sorts of data here lately, and leaving with large stacks of blueprints.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Data...?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: That reminds me. She asked me for all these weirdly specific details about the laundry room.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: The current diameter of the piping... The maximum flux of the drainage... and something about the water usage during cycles...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Oh no, I've been so worried about the maintenance these last couple days, I forgot all about that!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Hold on... So she's already good friends with Weedy, one of Engineering's most senior operators?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Weedy's always so busy, but even she's paying so much attention to Aroma. Look at me, though... Not only have I been overlooking her contributions, I even forgot about her request.

spans.text: Weedy's always so busy, but even
paying so much attention to Aroma. Look at me, though... Not only have I been overlooking her contributions, I even forgot about her request.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: No wonder she never talked to me about what comes after her formal employment. It's already a done deal...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: It's too late. It's all over...

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Engineering Operator
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: It's okay. I understand.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: I respect her decision, but at least let me do one last thing for her. After all, we've worked together at Logistics for so long now.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Is this... an application to submit an engineering blueprint?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Hold on, why do you have the early design drafts of the hydrotherapy machine?! It even has the magazine publisher's phone number that I scribbled on there...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Oh, actually, I saw it over at Weedy's.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I came because I heard about the hydrotherapy machine from her.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Take a look at the documents in the back, too.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: A research report on the hair growth of operators of different races... This is so detailed!

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: You researched all this by yourself? Amazing...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: It's all thanks to everyone's help.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Please take a look and tell me if the improved design on the document is viable.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Yeah, I took a look at the application. There's nothing wrong with making modifications based on the hair characteristics of different races, but the hydrotherapy machine is still in testing. It hasn't been through final inspection yet.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Whether it can be mass-produced after the modifications, and whether it will be installed in the changing rooms and the communal bath, all depends on Closure's approval.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: No need to worry about that. I've already checked with Weedy, and there's room for new equipment in the bath.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I'll keep working with you to test it, and there are plenty of operators willing to volunteer to test the improved version.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: ...But why go this far for this?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: This is just a beauty treatment I designed for the experiment section. How come this is so important all of a sudden...?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: What's this about, Aroma?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Actually... Rhodes Island is going through a hair loss crisis.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Wait, Purestream, what are you moving?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I don't remember seeing anything like that on the trash disposal manifest...

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Huh? But I reported it!

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: All of this is our operators' hair. I got it from cleaning up around the landship!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: You mean... this entire pile is hair?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Yep! You just got here, so you probably don't know about this yet, right?

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: Lots of people onboard Rhodes Island shed hair every day.

steps.name: Purestream
steps.text: If we don't get this taken care of promptly, it'll take over both the water pipes and the air vents!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: But this seems kinda... excessive.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: No, if anything it's not enough.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: These pipelines go through Rhodes Island's power plant and propulsion systems. They aren't things you can redesign on a whim.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Let's try some other methods to take care of this.

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Like, say... Wait, what's wrong? Why are you staring at me like that?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Weedy... where were you just now?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Huh? I just got back from the cafeteria.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Were there a lot of people there, and you had to squeeze through the crowd?

steps.name: Weedy
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Don't move. You have a lot of hair on your shoulders. It must be from other people's tails...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Okay. I got it all.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: You don't look so good, Weedy...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Hey, don't point that disinfectant spray gun at me like that.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Sorry, Aroma!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Okay... I got it. I'll do this pile of laundry.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: But isn't this is the third time this month...? We can't keep closing the laundry room for maintenance.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: So... did Engineering ever say what's behind it?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: This probably sounds silly, but...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Actually, it's because the drainage pipes under the laundry machines keep getting clogged with hair. Every single one of them.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I'll ask Engineering and see if there's any way the sewage system can be modified.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Until it's completely fixed, we'll need to clean the laundry machines before we use them, every single time.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: I see... That's quite troublesome.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Yeah... It's not a problem we can realistically solve completely, but I still want to figure out if there's any way to reduce the hair we need to clean up.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Which is why I've been observing the operators while I'm working in different areas.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: And I realized that some people shed hair just from having it touch their zippers when closing them. And others carefully pull their tails from their pants before carefully grooming them every day.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: And it's not just tail hair, there's also head hair, ear hair, hair on the back of your necks... All of this gets on their clothes.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Other than that, there are some who use lint rollers to remove the hair on their clothes before putting them in the laundry machines. If they notice me watching, they even give me an embarrassed smile...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: It was only after that that I realized... there's a much more important truth behind this crisis: a lot of operators are worried about their shedding.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Although we've been trying to deal with the hair every day, we've never truly tried to take care of their worries.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I... want to do something for them.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: So that's why you want to improve and promote this hydrotherapy machine... But I don't think that's going to be enough. We'll need a lot other ways to go about this, won't we?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Yeah, absolutely.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: The cafeteria now has a couple of dishes that help with hair maintenance, and there will be even more choices in the future.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Logistics is also going to introduce new shampoos that are formulated for the hair of different races, too.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: And the work I had scheduled for this afternoon was to check on the anti-static equipment in the storage room.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: ...Okay, Aroma.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: I now completely understand just how persistent you can be.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Do you remember what we were discussing earlier?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: When I apply makeup, I always look for the part of the face most worthy of jazzing up first. That's the most important part.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: And whether I leave it all to the auto-modelers or grab a makeup brush myself depends on the situation.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Huh? What's with that response? Isn't that what you've been doing?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Actually, I'm not really sure about that...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I might have been thinking about it in a much simpler way... I just want to help solve a problem and make everyone's life better.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I think that's what all of us Rhodes Island operators should be doing.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: ...Well, thanks to you, I just got a new design idea. What do you think about adding a hair dyeing module to the hydrotherapy machine?

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: You mentioned in your report that there are a lot of people who aren't happy with their hair color...

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Anyway, I'm so glad we've got you around in Engineering now. No wonder Weedy's been taking such good care of you.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: What? Me, in Engineering...?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Hold on...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Aroma!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Rubber? Why are you here...?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: H-He-Here are the laundry room's full specs, structural diagrams, and detailed usage statistics! I brought everything for you!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: I'm really sorry; I forgot all about it! I hope I didn't delay your R&D work with Engineering!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Umm... Okay... but...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: I've already reassigned all your work at Logistics to our other operators!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: ...All my work? Huh?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Yeah, that's right.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: No wonder my schedule this afternoon's so empty... but why?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: You see, we're planning a party at the cafeteria to celebrate you passing your evaluation period and formally joining Engineering!

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Be sure to head over once you're done talking with Roberta. You won't be disappointed!

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: ...Is this some kind of misunderstanding? I'm not joining Engineering.

steps.name: Rubber and Roberta
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Starting next week, I'll be a formal member of the Logistics Department.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: So... you chose us?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: But aren't you participating in Roberta's seminars? And these schematics...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Oh, that's actually for my work at Logistics.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: But... didn't the other departments invite you to join them?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: ...That was actually just Procurement.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: And it was only because my family's been sending lots of our workshop's shampoos here, so Procurement thought I had some kind of special channel for purchasing them...

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I haven't so much as dabbled in engineering before, and I definitely don't compare to the professionals here... I know I'm not cut out for it.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: It's okay, Aroma. Even if we're in different departments, you're welcome to come chat and work with me any time.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: No, scratch that... You absolutely need to come. I just realized there's a lip gloss that might be absolutely perfect on you.

spans.text: to come. I just realized there's a lip gloss that might be absolutely perfect on you.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Anyway, this is all part of my research too... Ahem... Think about it, okay?

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: O-Okay...

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: So I got it all wrong.

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: Thank goodness... I had no idea how I was going to explain this to the department chief.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Huh? You're leaving already?

steps.name: Rubber
steps.text: I gotta share the good news with everybody! Maybe there's still time to switch the word 'Engineering' on the banner to 'Logistics'!

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: *sigh*... Thinking about it, this is kinda a shame. Here I thought I was getting a new lackey I could count on.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I'm sorry I didn't explain myself properly.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: It's okay. Nothing to worry about. Just leave the hydrotherapy machine's modifications to me.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: I mean, it's for everyone onboard Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: ...Mm. Thank you.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: Right, you asked me earlier if I ever want to go back to Siracusa, to my hometown. I think... Once all my work is all over and I have time for a vacation, I might go and have a look.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: There were things I couldn't overcome before that I should be able to now. And I trust that that's how it is for Siracusa too.

steps.name: Roberta
steps.text: Sounds good. Maybe we could go together, even.

steps.name: Aroma
steps.text: I'm looking forward to it.
